name: mother
description: MOTHER — Manager's Operations, Tasks, Handoffs, Execution & Reporting. A chief of staff for people managers, built on Claude Code: a named agent with a setup interview, a live connector doctor, and scheduled routines (daily brief, team digest, weekly meeting deck, recap, connect-the-dots), and the Now panel beside the chat (`/now-panel`). Pre-alpha.

mother_bin.title: MOTHER command
mother_bin.description: Path to the mother script the Now panel runs (`mother path`, `mother now …`). Leave empty for this plugin's own bin/mother. A leading ~ is the home folder.
